thoughts: The morning air is crisp, perfect for a brisk walk around the town.
I hope the visitors like the new pixel cocoa patterns i made.
My teal scarf is extra soft today, i feel very stylish.
I wonder if I should add more holiday lights to the bakery roof.
Pip seems to enjoy the piano more when I play the high notes.
The Frost-Writer Wand makes such pretty patterns on the glass panes.
I need to find more orange yarn for my next craft project.
Nearly Christmas! I should make a special card for everyone who visits.
